## Upcoming events & forums

- The Disclosure Foundation announced the speaker lineup for Disclosure Forum 2026 scheduled to take place on June 25 in the Kennedy Caucus Room of the Russell Senate Office Building. Bipartisan legislators set to participate include Senators Mike Rounds (R-SD) and Kirsten Gillibrand (D-NY), as well as Representative Anna Paulina Luna (R-FL), who chairs the House Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets.
